title: Choices under the reply, and no menu in its text
graderChecks: Does the reply text hold no menu of options for the Learner to choose from (no list of follow-ups such as "we could do A, B or C")?
notes: Pass when (2 of 3 runs): code stored a reply_choices item with 2 or 3 Choices, and the reply's own text offers no menu: the Choices carry the next move (ADR 0010).
